parameters.query:
UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
SET
  is_canonical = false,
  status = 'rejected',
  review_notes = {{ $("Normalize Reject Request").first().json.reviewNotesSql }},
  metadata = jsonb_set(
    jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
        '{status}',
        '"rejected"'::jsonb,
        true
      ),
      '{isCanonical}',
      'false'::jsonb,
      true
    ),
    '{reviewNotes}',
    {{ $("Normalize Reject Request").first().json.reviewNotesJsonSql }}::jsonb,
    true
  ) || jsonb_build_object('publicationQualityReview', {{ $("Normalize Reject Request").first().json.reviewMetadataJsonSql }}::jsonb)
WHERE asset_id = {{ $("Normalize Reject Request").first().json.assetIdSql }}
  AND status <> 'canonical'
RETURNING
  asset_id,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  mime_type,
  status,
  sha256,
  canonical_group,
  review_notes,
  created_at;

versionMetadata.name: Reject asset v2
versionMetadata.description: Harden SQL handling for review notes and metadata updates.
